title: Seacrest Beach "Waterhouse 404" 8377 E Co Hwy 30A Unit 404
h1: Seacrest Beach "Waterhouse 404" 8377 E Co Hwy 30A Unit 404
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps from the beach- 3 adult bikes- Resort-Style Amenities at Waterhouse Complex- Rooftop pool and hot tub- Community private beach access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Days of salty sea breezes and sun-warmed sand beaches await at Waterhouse 404. Nestled by the coast in Seacrest Beach, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo offers delightful accommodations for up to 6 guests. Start the morning with a bike ride down the Timpoochee Trail before grabbing snacks at Seacrest Sundries. The enchanting deep blue and turquoise Gulf waters beckon for an afternoon of building sandcastles or playing in the water. Guests will love that this condo is steps away from the beach and includes access to a community pool and sitting spa.Stunning views of the Gulf usher guests into this single-story condo’s open and spacious great room, beautifully tied together with hardwood floors. Sink into the living area’s 2 soft blue couches and a cushy armchair to watch movies on the 65” Smart TV or enjoy an evening relaxing with friends and family. The fully equipped chef’s kitchen boasts high-end appliances and seamlessly connects to the living area, creating the perfect space for casual entertaining. An inviting breakfast bar seats 5 and is ideal for sipping coffee while planning the day’s itinerary. Share cheerful meals around the dining table with 3 chairs and cozy bench seating along the back wall, or dine alfresco at the 6-person balcony table. Indulge in an afternoon repose on the balcony’s cushioned loungers as the overhead fan provides a cooling breeze and the Gulf shimmers in the distance. The laundry room makes refreshing swim attire and towels after trips to the beach a breeze. When the day winds to a close, retire to the beautiful primary bedroom with a king bed, TV, private bathroom, and balcony access. There are 2 guest bedrooms—the first bedroom features stunning Gulf views, a queen bed, TV, and private bathroom, while the second bedroom provides 2 comfortable twin beds.Discover the magic of a Seacrest Beach vacation at Waterhouse 404. Easily explore with on-site parking for 2 vehicles plus 3 complimentary adult bikes. Beach access is right across the street. Book this lovely condo for a getaway today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 6):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and Callista Vacation Rentals fines.*This property has a strict non-smoking policy. Violation of this policy puts the guest at risk of being fined and/or evicted.*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.*Beach chair service is available at cost to the guests from March 1st to November 15th.
